title: Mangusta motor yacht Namaste sold
description: The 41.40 metre motor yacht Namaste, listed for sale by the Mangusta Brokerage Division, has been sold with the buyer introduced by Ralph Navarro at Florida Yachts International.
html:
The 41.40 metre motor yacht Namaste, listed for sale by the Mangusta Brokerage Division, has been sold with the buyer introduced by Ralph Navarro at Florida Yachts International.

Built in steel and aluminum by Overmarine to a design by Alberto Mancini and MCA classed, Namaste was delivered in 2017 as the first hull in the Mangusta Oceano 42 series.

Accommodation is for up to 12 guests in five cabins consisting of a main deck master suite with a private balcony, two doubles, and two twins, with quarters for seven crew. In the main saloon, sliding doors to port and starboard fill the area with natural light while large windows provide panoramic sea views.

Her exterior highlights include a foredeck infinity pool with sunloungers on either side, complete with a cascading waterfall and skylights at the bottom that flood the owner’s bathroom below with light. Aft, glass windows in the swim platform provide great views of the water below while allowing natural light into the air-conditioned beach club when the transom door is closed. The swim platform also features an al-fresco shower and underwater spotlights that illuminate the yacht at night.

Twin 1,448hp MTU diesel engines offer a cruising speed of 11 knots topping out at 15 knots and a range of 4,500 nautical miles. For added comfort at sea and in port, she is fitted with zero speed stabilisers.

Namaste was asking €18,000,000.
